terms.comment: Traupman’s description: “the middle part of the body”.

terms.gloss: round the middle, by the waist
evidence: Ter. Ad. 3.2.18: medium arripere aliquem (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Latin says “to clasp someone middle”: aliquem medium complectī, to put one’s arms round someone’s waist.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 59, checked against the searchable text of the book.
